G25 amended (19 October, D3a-20; applies backwards to this group's lines), written under G25 in notes-D3.md before any line's hours were printed. G25's timing sentence read A09's bound more widely than its words; QD3-007 read A07's bound in its own words, and I read A09's the same way. A later canvas or an emblem (banner, sidebar image, logo, flair, emoji) planned before the close is a specification naming A09. 'Near the close' is read as hour 61 to hour 73. A tie carried on, the work remade elsewhere, or a new purpose for the canvas sub or chat, shown only before hour 61, is a paired elaboration of P13 (G4a clause 4); a restrict or contradict line arguing this timing shows no P13 failing, so it is an elaboration, not a correction. Lines already ruled on the superseded sentence are found by d3_line_hours.py --after 61 and re-ruled by appended lines. No element or arrow changes; the family 'keeping begun while building' goes to D4 beside A09's bound
